eventhub.reason: Guard implemented; no valid active target/task policy exists and no runtime start authorized yet.
eventhub.required_guard: Decode each received real SQS envelope without processor execution, require exact approved account + target origin/serial + a registered test task trace_id + explicit allowed response content type; forward the original unchanged SQS record to production handler. Reject/hold everything else in this dedicated test queue. Never synthesize responses.
eventhub.why_not_sns_only: The stock filter supports account_guid message attributes; task trace and target origin live inside encrypted payloads, so stock account filtering alone cannot enforce this.
remaining_decisions: Create bounded current policy and register each actual returned task ID
eventhub.planned_core: Dedicated response_worker screens real messages using production codec, then invokes unchanged production async handler. Only the synchronous wrapper bridge is omitted to keep one event loop.
eventhub.race_handling: Unregistered trace held on the private queue for up to 300 seconds while caller atomically registers returned task UUID; registered processing failures remain queued for retry.
eventhub.outbound_guard_effect: Only dedicated response-worker process is patched to forbid outbound commands. API command transport and production handler implementation remain unchanged.
